purpose: Stateless MQTT->Kafka ingestion bridge consuming EMQX $share/maintai-ingest QoS 1 messages and routing validated AI4I events to sensor.readings or HASH_ONLY rejections to sensor.rejected.
boundaries: Stateless MQTT->Kafka router: schema/allowlist envelope guard only; zero DB, DQ/ML, or SSE logic.
Emits sensor.readings (1.3.0) and sensor.rejected (1.4.0 HASH_ONLY) with lz4 + idempotent_write and 4 required Kafka headers.
